images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: FRONT-view concept art of one LEFT brown leather ankle boot, starter priest footwear for a modular fantasy RPG.
Input image 1: existing priest character, palette and material context ONLY. The user has explicitly rejected the sandals in this reference and approved replacing them with practical CLOSED brown leather ankle boots, a single silver buckle, and room for chainmail trouser hems tucked inside.
Primary request: draw exactly one empty LEFT-foot ankle boot, straight frontal elevation, toe pointing directly at the viewer. A simple modest medieval fantasy traveling boot that complements the reference's brown belt and silver fittings. Fully enclosed rounded toe and heel, supple medium-dark brown leather upper, restrained natural grain and subtle creases, tidy tonal edge stitching, plain overlapping front shaft closure with a continuous gusset underneath. One narrow leather strap encircles the upper ankle and fastens with exactly ONE small plain rectangular silver buckle on the wearer's OUTER ankle (image RIGHT in the front view). No other decorative metal. Low stacked dark brown leather sole, low broad walking heel, no modern tread.
The short shaft ends a little above the ankle bones, below the lower calf, with an adequately wide hollow opening to accommodate tucked-in chainmail trouser hems. No chainmail itself in the image. Short practical ankle boot, not a tall calf boot. Closed leather vamp covering the entire foot, no cutouts or exposed toes. All parts naturally connected as a single wearable object. Anatomical left-foot last for later mirroring in 3D.
Composition: one boot only, centered large with generous white margins, direct straight FRONT view, near orthographic, no side rotation, no three-quarter view, no top-down view. Slight visibility of the empty shaft opening is fine. Whole boot from sole to shaft rim visible, no crop.
Style: polished realistic fantasy equipment concept illustration, clearly readable construction, soft even studio lighting, solid pure white background, no floor or exterior cast shadow.
Avoid: sandals, open toes, holes in upper, bare foot, toes, skin, legs, human, mannequin, socks, trousers or chainmail inside boot, second boot, multiple views, laces, zippers, elastic panels, modern rubber sole, high heels, metal toe caps, gold, jewels, medallions, religious symbols, extra buckles, studs, spikes, text, annotations, dimensions, logos, watermark.
